description: Market-exploration outputs recorded before the exploration script was connected to the dbt marts.

findings.H01: The 41 CMAs contain 1,009,239 SME employer locations; the median CMA has 7,986 and the largest (Toronto) has 264,670.
findings.H02: SME locations are concentrated: the 3 largest CMAs hold 52.1% and the 5 largest 64.1% of the 41-CMA total; 3 CMAs account for half.
findings.H03: The 1-499 band is 99.54% to 99.91% of employer locations in every CMA.
findings.H04: Unclassified locations are 6.7% of SME locations at the median CMA (range 4.3% to 12.7%; highest: St. John's).
findings.H05: Public administration (NAICS 91) is 0.35% of SME locations at the median CMA, up to 2.10% (Fredericton); it is excluded from the 19-sector denominator.
findings.H06: Median SME locations: Tier 1 15,429, Tier 2 5,603, Tier 3 4,060; Tier 1 holds 90.4% of the 41-CMA total.
findings.H07: Across 35 CMAs the 12-month mean monthly opening rate ranges 2.59% to 5.90% (median 4.48%); closure rate median 4.38%.
findings.H08: 27 of 35 CMAs had a positive 12-month mean net-formation rate; the median was 0.033% per month.
findings.H09: Net-formation rate rose versus the prior 12 months in 22 of 35 CMAs; 0 of 35 changes exceed the 2-SE noise heuristic.
findings.H10: The 36-month linear trend in net-formation rate is positive in 16 of 35 CMAs.
findings.H11: Summed 12-month net formation differs from the change in active enterprises (median absolute gap 12 enterprises).
findings.H12: Month-to-month volatility of net-formation rate ranges 0.173% to 0.724% (12-month SD); highest in Abbotsford - Mission.
findings.H13: All 35 eligible CMAs have 12 of 12 usable months for every core momentum series; 0 E-flagged and 0 unavailable observations in the recent window.
findings.H14: Complete 12-month opening and closing rates exist for the 1-4 band in 35 CMAs and for the 5-19 band in 22; active counts for 5-19 are complete in 35.
findings.H15: The largest SME sector is 'Health care and social assistance' in 17 of 41 CMAs.
findings.H16: Sector HHI ranges 0.085 (Brantford, most diversified) to 0.105 (Ottawa - Gatineau, most concentrated); effective number of sectors 9.6 to 11.8.
findings.H17: 47 CMA x sector cells are materially over-represented (LQ >= 1.5, >= 10 locations, |z| >= 3); the largest is Mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction in Red Deer (LQ 8.81, 90 locations).
findings.H18: 39 of 779 CMA x business-sector cells have fewer than 10 SME locations; their shares and LQs are unstable.
findings.H19: 1-4 employee locations are 51.8% of SME locations at the median CMA (range 43.1% to 64.3%); 100-499 is 1.95%.
findings.H20: 3 CMAs have a size-band share at least 2 SD from the 41-CMA mean: Saguenay (20-99), Trois-Rivières (20-99), Toronto (1-4;5-19).
findings.H21: The smallest CMA-level 100-499 count is 55 locations (Nanaimo); at CMA x sector x 100-499 only 37.4% of cells have 10+ locations (Phase F).
findings.H22: The national external-financing request rate is 49.3%; 4 of 24 usable CMA estimates are distinguishable from it, and 40 of 276 CMA pairs.
findings.H23: The national debt request rate is 25.7%; 2 of 24 usable CMA estimates are distinguishable from it, and 26 of 276 CMA pairs.
findings.H24: Product-level approval rates at CMA level include 20 F and 19 E estimates out of 96.
findings.H25: Six Tier 3 CMAs have scale and composition evidence but no 0722 momentum history; they stay visible and are excluded from momentum comparisons.
findings.H26: scale vs net-formation rate: Spearman rho = 0.08 (n = 35).
findings.H27: opening rate vs net-formation rate: Spearman rho = -0.01 (n = 35).
findings.H28: closure rate vs net-formation rate: Spearman rho = -0.13 (n = 35).
findings.H29: recent net-formation level vs change: Spearman rho = 0.59 (n = 35).
findings.H30: scale vs sector concentration: Spearman rho = -0.16 (n = 41).
findings.H31: scale vs micro-location share: Spearman rho = 0.61 (n = 41).
findings.H32: external-financing vs debt request rate: Spearman rho = 0.44 (n = 24).
findings.H33: 13 of 24 quantitative candidates have Tukey extremes; none are removed or winsorized.
